claims.claim: Cathulu should preserve justified durable knowledge and provenance while keeping active scope context bounded. Memory class and retrieval temperature are independent; SQLite remains authoritative; raw evidence is promoted, compacted, or deleted only through a staged, evidence-based lifecycle.
Cathulu owns persistent local project/personal state, memory, policy and evidence; Claude Code and Codex are replaceable cognition/execution providers.
Current dirty source already implements SQLite through schema 18, FTS5, memory lifecycle, stable Main/PM identities and durable Codex event routing; this does not prove current loaded/live behavior.
Current dispatch starts PM/Worker threads at the registered project path; worktree reconciliation does not allocate exclusive writer workspaces.
